info.name: Studiothree Discover API
info.description: Postman collection for the Studiothree Discover backend. Live routes include Conversations (chat) and Collections. Inquiries (/api/inquiries) are deferred and not registered. Set collection variables: baseUrl, accessToken, username, pieceId, postId, seriesId, addressId, orderId, notificationId, conversationId, collectionId.

request.description: Check username availability. Enable for_user_id=me and add Bearer token when changing username.
Returns savesCount/likesCount aggregated across the seller's pieces, salesCount (completed orders), and inquiriesCount (inquiry threads received).
Lightweight list: likeCount/isLiked/isSaved; commentCount 0; no series/relatedPosts.
Upsert by pushToken (reassigns ownership if the token was previously registered to a different user, e.g. shared device).
latitude/longitude come from the client's map picker; the backend never geocodes.
Lightweight list: likeCount/isLiked/isSaved; commentCount 0; piece null.
Haversine-based distance query (no PostGIS) — returns sellers with lat/lng set, ordered by distance. Send Bearer for viewer-specific isFollowing.

Enriched detail: author, piece (full linked piece summary when linkedPieceId set), likeCount, commentCount, isLiked, isSaved.
